CA-copy-statement, CA-extra-work-note and CA-7159 print for contracts over $500 (B&P 7159(b)), but contracts of $750 or less that meet all the service and repair conditions use B&P 7159.10 instead; the builder cannot tell.
CA-extra-work-note: the heading 'Note About Extra Work and Change Orders' is a separate quoted phrase in the statute and cannot be joined to the statement, so only the statement is cut.

Not loaded (headings or described, not worded): 7159(d)(3), (5), (6), (7), (10), (11), (12) headings; (c)(3)(B) first-page items; (c)(4) lien-release statement; (c)(6) bond notice; (e)(3) change-order notice; 7164(d) bond notice; checkbox statements for attached notices; five-day (senior) versions; 7159.10 headings and the parts-offer statements.
CA-downpayment and CA-progress-payments are stored, not printed: the builder cannot tell whether a downpayment or progress payments are charged, and bonded contractors are exempt (7159.5(a)(8)).
CA-cgl-*, CA-wc-*, CA-subs-disclaimer are stored: which statement applies depends on facts the builder does not hold.
CA-cslb: the 7159(e)(5) wording was used, not 7030(b); they differ by one comma ('disciplinary actions, and civil judgments').
CA-1689.7: stored because home improvement contracts are excluded from it and the builder cannot tell a home improvement job from a cleaning plan.
